name: Browser Handoff
description: Give the user the browser for what they must do themselves: a login that isn't saved (try browser-login first), a 2FA code, a CAPTCHA, a payment. Returns a Card line: put it in your reply, say what they should do, and end the reply. Your browser actions are refused until then; when they say they're done, call with done: true to take it back.
author: anything

reason.description: What the user should do, shown to them, e.g. "log in to LinkedIn".

done.description: true once the user says they're finished.
